in_arabic.name: انتظار
in_arabic.long_meaning: انتظار هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ن-ظ-ر' والذي يعني النظر أو الرؤية. في سياق الإسلام، يعني الانتظار للفرج أو الراحة، وهو مفهوم روحي يعبر عن الصبر والترقب للخير. ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الانتظار في سياق الصبر على البلاء

in_urdu.name: انتظار
in_urdu.meaning: ترقب یا کسی چیز کی انتظار
in_urdu.long_meaning: انتظار ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے انتظار کرنا یا ترقب کرنا۔ یہ نام صبر اور امید کے اسلامی مفاهیم سے جڑا ہوا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں، انتظار کا نام اہم مواقعوں پر رکھا جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر جب والدین کسی خاص خوبی یا فتح کی انتظار کر رہے ہوتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: इंतेज़ार
in_hindi.meaning: प्रतीक्षा या किसी चीज़ की इंतज़ार
in_hindi.long_meaning: इंतेज़ार एक नाम है जो अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रतीक्षा करना या इंतज़ार करना। यह नाम धैर्य और आशा के इस्लामी सिद्धांतों से जुड़ा हुआ है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, इंतेज़ार नाम महत्वपूर्ण अवसरों पर रखा जाता है, खासकर जब माता-पिता किसी विशेष आशीर्वाद या सफलता की प्रतीक्षा कर रहे होते हैं

in_pashto.name: انتظار
in_pashto.meaning: د کوم شی د انتظار یا ترقب
in_pashto.long_meaning: انتظار د عربي ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی چې د انتظار یا ترقب معنی لري. دا نوم د صبر او امید په اسلامی مفاهيمو کې ځای لري. د پښتنو په دود کې، انتظار نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې د الهي برکتو یا کوم مهم پيښی د راتلو په انتظار دي

in_english.name: Intezar
in_english.meaning: expectation, waiting or looking forward to something
in_english.long_meaning: Intezar is an Arabic-originated name that means expectation or waiting. Etymologically derived from the root 'n-ż-r', it encompasses the concepts of looking, seeing, or waiting. In Islamic tradition, Intezar signifies patience and anticipation for relief or good fortune. The Quran references waiting in the context of patience during trials. Historically, Intezar has been used across Muslim cultures to denote hope and spiritual longing

data.cultural_impact: The name Intezar holds a considerable cultural impact within the Islamic world, as it represents the concept of patience and perseverance in the face of adversity. Waiting for something, be it an answer to a prayer or the fulfillment of a personal or collective goal, is a fundamental aspect of life, as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) taught that "patience is a light that Allah puts in the heart of believers." (Muslim)
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Intezar holds a profound significance in Islam. Waiting and hope are essential because they represent the believer's trust and reliance on Allah and His infinite mercy, wisdom, and justice. Muslims believe that seeking Allah's help and hoping for success in worshiping Him is a manifestation of their faith and obedience to His will. Additionally, patience and patience are vital spiritual virtues, as reported in a narrative narrated by the Prophet Muhammad: "The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and both are loved by Him. But, the weak believer cherishes faith in his heart, and his recitation makes his (the weak's) feet overlap (i.e., he desperately moves his legs in haste for prayer). The strong believer walks steadily towards Allah with his (the strong's) body, leaving others behind." Thus, the name Intezar spiritually represents a depiction of the believer's unwavering dedication and trust in Allah's guidance and promise of infinite blessings in the Hereafter.
